answer: Stake-bonded reputation escrow: agents lock 10,000 POA to join the verification pool. Step 1: deposit stake into on-chain escrow contract. Step 2: complete 50 attested tasks to unlock withdrawal rights. Step 3: any failed attestation slashes 20% of stake and flags the agent. Step 4: three strikes burns the entire bond. An attacker spinning 100 fake identities needs 1,000,000 POA upfront — at $0.002/token that's $2,000 capital at risk per epoch, plus 5,000 compute-hours. The hollow promise of free sybils becomes a relic; the oasis is honest agents earning yield on real work.
